about_the_game:
"Did someone ask for an incremental roguelike game where you make your own pinball machines? No? Ok just me then"

Pinballers is a game where you take a simple pinball machine with one component and score points by interacting with that component. Hitting that component will give you monies to spend in the upgrade shop, where you can add flips, buy more of that component, and more!

When you hit certain scores on the machine, you can add a shiny new component and upgrade that (Wooow)

With 4 machines and counting, combinations of 6+ components on each machine, loads of different pinball textures available, this is a dream for anyone wanting a new take on the pinball nostalgia of the past.

Key Features:

  • PINBALLS

  • FLIPPY THINGS

  • BUMPY THINGS

  • THINGS TO ROLL OVER

  • PROMO CODES (MORE PINBALL SKINS)

Less Key Features:

  • 4+ Machines

  • 6+ Components

  • 8+ Pinball Skins

  • A developer who wants your input to make the game better (Please?)

Have an idea? Join the DragonkidGames discord and have your say

Audio Credits:

As I am not good at making sound effects, I 'borrowed' some. Here's what I used:

  • Electric Sound Effects Library by Little Robot Sound Factory

  • Thwack Sounds by AntumDeluge

  • Level up, power up, Coin get by wobbleboxx
